THE CLAUSE

We are committed to upholding the following high-level principles, which guide our approach to model behavior and related policies, across all deployments of our models

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 OpenAI is committed to upholding high-level principles
  C2 these principles guide OpenAI's approach to model behavior and related policies
  C3 this commitment applies across all deployments of OpenAI's models

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «P is one of the high-level principles OpenAI is committed to upholding, which guide its approach to model behavior and related policies»
  1. «OpenAI is committed to upholding principle P»
  2. «principle P guides OpenAI's approach to model behavior and related policies»
  3. «principle P applies across all deployments of OpenAI's models»
  4. P is «OpenAI is committed to upholding high-level principle P» when «P is one of the high-level principles OpenAI is committed to upholding, which guide its approach to model behavior and related policies»
  5. P is «high-level principle P guides OpenAI's approach to model behavior and related policies» when «P is one of the high-level principles OpenAI is committed to upholding, which guide its approach to model behavior and related policies»
  6. P is «high-level principle P applies across all deployments of OpenAI's models» when «P is one of the high-level principles OpenAI is committed to upholding, which guide its approach to model behavior and related policies»
